body:
Found reviewing #863.

`docs/data/label_index.csv` has two `resolved:owned` rows for the label `Fe2(SO4)3 x n H2O`:
- the preferred term of `kgmicrobe.compound:fe2_so43_x_n_h2o` (MAPPED);
- a `RAW_TEXT` synonym of `UNMAPPED_0385` (`data/ingredients/unmapped/FeSO43_X_N_H2O.yaml`, preferred term `FeSO43 x n H2O`, 0 occurrences).

claw's builder keeps the first row, so the label anchors to the mapped record, and #863's rejection-ledger row for CHEBI:53438 applies. If the row order changes, the label would anchor to UNMAPPED_0385, the ledger row would no longer match it, and the anhydrous recipe id could come back through the fallback.

UNMAPPED_0385's own deep-research notes describe the same iron(III) sulfate hydrate. It looks like a duplicate of the mapped record, a merge candidate under the merge-ingredients procedure. At minimum, its `Fe2(SO4)3 x n H2O` synonym should not compete for the mapped record's preferred term.
title: UNMAPPED_0385 'FeSO43 x n H2O' competes for the Fe2(SO4)3 x n H2O label; the #863 ledger row relies on row order
